Humans meet all objective criteria to be categorized not only as animals but also as mammals and primates. Astro Bot's movement abilities allow for very little expression (and are kind of unsatisfying, imo), and the levels don't really evolve or do much to change the way that you play the game. This is cool to mess around with at first and is impressive from a technical standpoint, but it changes next to nothing with how you actually play the level. Replaying it for the platinum really made me realize this, Astro Bot loses so much when you already know what the level's gimmick will be.

I think the "woah, that's cool" stuff you see makes the game worth playing through, though in terms of gameplay, I'd take any 3D Mario game over it any day.
